name: SBI Holdings, Inc.
summary: SBI Holdings, Inc. engages in investment businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five business segments: Financial Services Business, Asset Management Business, PE Investment Business, Crypto-Asset Business, and Next Gen Business segments. Its Financial Services Business segment consists of a range of finance-related business, including securities brokerage business; banking services business; and life, property, and casualty insurance businesses. The Asset Management Business segment includes setting, solicitation, and management of investment trust; investment advice; and financial products information.
